means.idiom-jp: おそらく…するだろう；…するのはもっともだ
means.example-sentence: I thought he said he was coming, but I may well not have heard him right.
means.sentence-jp: 彼は来ると言ったと思ったが、おそらく私が正しく聞いていなかったのだろう。

cloze.maskedText: I thought he said he was coming, but I ____.
cloze.answerSurface: may well not have heard him right
choices: may well not have heard him right
might just as well talk to a brick wall

notes: well には very が付くことも多い。may を might や could に変えれば控えめな表現になる。
